rows.note: Use 教育 as the all-purpose noun for the process or general idea of education.

example.english: Education isn't just studying; it also includes teaching people how to conduct themselves.
example.traditional: 教育唔係淨係讀書，仲包括教人點樣做人。
example.jyutping: gaau3 juk6 m4 hai6 zing6 hai6 duk6 syu1 zung6 baau1 kut3 gaau3 jan4 dim2 joeng2 zou6 jan4

rows.note: Use 學歷 when you mean someone’s schooling or educational qualifications rather than education as a process or body of knowledge.

example.english: Have you clearly written your education qualifications on your résumé?
example.traditional: 你份履歷寫清楚學歷未呀？
example.jyutping: nei5 fan6 leoi5 lik6 se2 cing1 co2 hok6 lik6 mei6 aa3

rows.note: Use 學識 when you mean the knowledge and learning a person has acquired rather than their educational credentials.

example.english: They have a broad education and can talk about anything.
example.traditional: 佢學識好廣，乜嘢都識講。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hok6 sik1 hou2 gwong2 mat1 je5 dou1 sik1 gong2
